title: AASD: Accelerate Inference by Aligning Speculative Decoding in Multimodal Large Language Models
problem: Multimodal LLM inference is slow due to auto-regressive decoding with long token sequences; traditional acceleration methods compromise quality or multimodal integration.
motivation: Speculative decoding can accelerate inference; alignment between draft and target models in multimodal settings is challenging due to complex token dependencies.
method: AASD leverages cached KV pairs from target model to generate draft tokens efficiently. A KV Projector compresses KV cache while preserving fidelity. Target-Draft Attention mechanism optimizes alignment between draft and target models.
key_novelty: Target-Draft Attention mechanism achieving alignment-aware speculative decoding for multimodal LLMs with minimal computational overhead.
contributions: Speculative decoding framework using target model KV pairs for efficient draft token generation
KV Projector for lossless KV cache compression maintaining representational fidelity
Target-Draft Attention mechanism optimizing draft-target alignment
Up to 2x inference speedup without accuracy loss across mainstream MLLMs
limitations: Applicability to other modalities (audio, video) and very large MLLMs (e.g., >70B params) not discussed.
primary_theme: Aligned speculative decoding for efficient multimodal LLM inference
